description: Run RTL lint / methodology checks and triage each violation into a real fix vs a justified, documented waiver. Use when the user says "lint my RTL", "code quality", "review my RTL", "check my Verilog/VHDL", "any latches / unintended latches", "clean up warnings before synthesis", "is my design lint-clean", or asks for a code-quality / methodology report on an FPGA design. Requires the SynthPilot MCP server (Xilinx Vivado running with the Tcl server connected on TCP:9999). Methodology-stage checks additionally require an open synthesized design (open_synthesized_design / open_implemented_design).
